# Copilot instructions for Product Craft Korea

- Treat `AGENTS.md` as the primary repository guide.
- Keep the project dependency-free unless the user explicitly requests a framework migration.
- Prefer focused edits to `index.html`; preserve its Korean copy, visual system, responsive breakpoints, and accessibility behavior.
- Maintain the live connection to `RefoundAI/lenny-skills` and the fallback link when loading fails.
- Preserve source attribution and never embed copyrighted podcast transcripts or long quotations.
- Do not commit secrets, API keys, tokens, or user data.
- Before completing a change, verify search, category filters, modal interactions, installation-command copying, and GitHub Pages deployment compatibility.
- Summarize modified files and user-visible effects in every pull request or commit description.
